notes: CONTROLLER: pick your class with the controller before the match starts; the mouse cursor hides while you use a controller and comes back as soon as you touch the mouse or keyboard; button prompts show controller buttons
TEXT CHAT: Enter to chat in a match (Tab switches ALL / PARTY), party chat in the lobby, quick-chat buttons, mute players. Match chat clears when the next match starts
VOICE CHAT (desktop app): push to talk (V / D-pad left) or open mic, with volume, mic sensitivity and muting in the new pause menu panel
GRENADES: no longer pass through walls, floors and ceilings inside buildings; hold the grenade button to see a dotted path of where it will go, let go to throw
DZ: every finished match now pays DZ (40, +2 a kill, +30 for a win, online +25%)
